negative_reviews.author: M. Alameen
negative_reviews.text: The sushi was just okay, but I’ve had much better. The place is decent. I haven’t tried the ramen; it seems to be a more popular dish than sushi.

negative_reviews.author: Lily
negative_reviews.text: The server was very aggressive towards us and I felt harassed during my time in the restaurant. I had a horrible time all throughout and I have to say this wasn't only with one staff member it was multiple. I would've preferred there to have been no server instead. I will not be returning as this is also a reoccurring issue with not only me but many of my friends as well. The portions were significantly smaller at the Eldon square one than the one in MetroCentre. I won't be dining here again.

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo Weekly Dash PDF overview (Sales Overview) — gap-site weekly sales; ops metrics not in this source. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers rose to 1,708, up 324 week on week and up 76 year on year, boosted by the £5 student lock-in on Monday with a queue down the street.
Spend per head fell to £16.92, down £1.70 week on week and down £5.74 year on year.
Guests coming in mainly for £5 ramen are not adding extras and only take tap water, during a big swell in students.
Drinks were at -0.62% (up 0.63% week on week), sushi at -1.02% (up 0.27%) and sides at -0.59% (down 0.67%).
Sales were £35,622.57, up £5,555.15 (15.59%) week on week and down £6,401.14 (15.23%) year on year.
Sales beat the £30,000 target by £5,622.57 (18.74%), the strongest against target in the region.
Labour was 20.97% with absolute minimal hours in play; sales are rising despite daily discounts, so the site is looking for more staff and easing labour during the week.
Food cost was 24.15%, about £1,000 over budget because of the student fair £5 vouchers and free ramen, and Penny warned the month is already at 25% after two weeks.
With the extra discounts the site keeps running out of food when told to cut ordering, and Ka has agreed to authorise extra costs within reason if checked with him first.
Food variance was -3.7% and drinks variance 4%.
Deliveroo late prepared orders and inaccurate orders are higher than wanted, partly from items missed while running tables, though prep time is still good.
Four Deliveroo refunds were for a missed drink (site error), a dessert that was given to the driver, a missing main and a missing Coke.
Deliveroo is up at weekends thanks to an unexpected 50% off promotion from Friday to Sunday for the next few weeks, alongside 40% off daily.
The site received nineteen 5 star, three 4 star, one 3 star and one 1 star Google reviews.
A 1 star review on 28/09 described a server as very aggressive during the £5 student lock-in; the GM says the server only reacted after the guest swore at the team.
A 3 star review said the sushi was okay but better elsewhere.
Weekly hygiene compliance dropped because cleaning checks were not done on Wednesday, Thursday or Sunday.
Fire safety and ventilation visits took place on 01/10.
The air conditioning is an extreme priority job with Ross, first visited on 11/05.
The front door needs a service and the accessible lift still needs checking, both medium priority with Ross.
The first ladies toilet is leaking from a cracked pipe, and Kris is coming on Thursday to fix it.
FOH recruitment is struggling as every applicant contacted turned down a trial invite, and a BOH advert, possibly temporary, is going out, ideally with one hire per section.
The GM has asked whether Metro (M15) FOH staff want extra shifts.
The GM has told the head chef that extra labour must bring a big improvement in FOH and BOH cleanliness, or hours will be cut back.
Staff still have around 20 days of holiday each, and a new chef will be needed around January to February.
More staff, cleaning, air conditioning and compliance are the stated areas for improvement.
App discounts, the lunch menu, Deliveroo offers and XOXO are the upcoming promotions.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): last week's chicken broth usage discrepancy was traced to a takeaway recipe still linked to the old tonkotsu broth in stock counts, which has been corrected, so usage should return to normal next week.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): Bidfood is being brought in as a new supplier, starting with Aberdeen and reaching the other sites within one to two months, and new beef samples are being trialled with a view to pre-cooked beef so sites no longer cook it themselves.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): frozen ramen promotion stock is delivered from the factory on 07/10, but storage space at the smaller sites is unconfirmed and the memo does not specify quantities per flavour.
